    // The items of node `node` and of its four subtrees, restricted to nodes
    // whose bounds meet the query.
    QuadtreeCandidates(self: Quadtree2D, bounds: Bounds2D, node: SpatialNodeIndex): Array<ItemIndex>
        => node.Value < 0
            ? self.ItemIndices.Take(0)
            : self.QuadtreeNodeCandidates(bounds, self.Nodes[node.Value]);
